name: Rion Kunisada
source: Rion is a member of the LWC. He is the son of the boss of the LWC, Sein, and lost his mother when he was young, causing him to be awkward with his father since then. He has a very intense personality with high pride. After Yuuri arrives, he takes an interest in him despite the fact that numerous people already like him for his graceful looks. Because he is so stubborn, he is constantly butting heads with Roy.
